component.name: Photon Studio
component.summary: Offline photo editor with layers, masks, retouching and PSD support

description.p: This is a community package of Photon Studio, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

Photon Studio is a free desktop photo editor. Edit photos, create layered designs, and open or save Photoshop documents. Everything runs on your computer: there is no account and no upload step, and even subject selection and background removal run locally.

ul.li: Layers, groups, masks, adjustment layers, smart objects and layer effects
Retouching with healing tools and Liquify
Text and vector shapes for design work
Open and save PSD and PSB files
Camera RAW, HEIF, AVIF and JPEG XL support
Curves with a live preview, and a command search for every tool

description.p: This package can read and write your Pictures, Documents and Downloads folders, where Photon saves new documents by default. A Photon document is a folder rather than a single file, and edits to RAW photos are kept in a settings file next to the photo, so saving outside those folders needs a broader permission. To let Photon save anywhere in your home folder, as upstream's own Flatpak bundle does:
Updates arrive through this remote. The in-app update notice links to upstream's download page and can be ignored.
